notes: Tuition: the programme page states a €500 additional service fee for new non-EU students, stated as due as part of the enrolment process in addition to the semester fee; it does not state an amount for the semester fee itself, nor a yearly tuition fee. The DAAD page says 'Tuition fees per semester Varied' with no figure, and 'Semester contribution 102 EUR', which is a contribution, not tuition. No total tuition figure for non-EU students could be quoted, so only the €500 non-EU service fee is given. Application deadlines are quoted from the DAAD programme page; the HS Kempten application pages give general periods (e.g. winter semester approx. mid-April to 31 August; general winter semester 2027/2028 mid-April 2027 to 15 July 2027) and the programme page says application runs online via MeinCampus, while the foreign-diploma route requires the uni-assist VPD first, so applicationChannel is set to de-uni-assist-vpd.
